items.title: Next Sunday at Winners Chapel International Milwaukee Wisconsin
items.content: Good News! Next Sunday shall be our New Dawn Banquet Service. It shall be a service to be much remembered. We are all required to come along with our new converts, invitees, and other loved ones to partake of the wonders that await us in this service.

items.title: Covenant Hour of Prayer
items.content: Monday–Friday: 6:00 AM – 7:00 AM (online via WhatsApp); Saturday: 8:00 AM (in-person)

items.title: Midweek Communion Service
items.content: Our Midweek Communion Service holds every Wednesday. We shall be observing a fast and break with the communion.

items.title: AYAC 2026
items.content: Annual Youth Alive Convention will hold from 18th August to 22nd August 2026. The theme is NEXT LEVELS.

items.title: Winners Satellite Fellowship
items.content:
Our house-to-house fellowship is held every Saturday at our WSF Centers across our cities and counties in Wisconsin. 
Members are encouraged to attend with their new converts and invitees at the centre nearest to them.

items.title: Believers Foundation Class
items.content: Our BFC for all our new converts and new members will start immediately after every service. Everyone who is yet to take this class since joining this commission should take advantage of this very important platform for spiritual empowerment that will lead to victorious living. Every first timer is encouraged to see our ministers in the room beside prosperity, as we have a gift for them.

items.title: Free Transport
items.content: Contact the Transport Ministry to pre-book a ride to church. Call: 414-255-4387

items.title: Pastoral Rescue Line
items.content: Members are encouraged to call the Pastoral Rescue Lines for matters requiring prayers and urgent attention. Phone Numbers: +1(414)-368-7753
